summary.en: In Osaka prefecture, Heizo Hattori is discussing with Detective Toyama about two murders reported in their prefecture. There were no eyewitnesses in any of the cases while they share the same method: A stab wound on both victims’ chest wallet pockets that pierces to their heart. Location: Toyonaka City, Osaka Prefecture Victim: Hidetoshi Nagao Cause of death: Strangulation and stab wound Location: Hirakata City, Osaka Prefecture Victim: Tayo Nishiguchi Cause of death: Strangulation and stab wound Meanwhile, Heiji is taking Conan, Ran, and Kogoro to Osaka prefecture to visit under the guidance of a volunteer Osaka officer Yusuke Sakata. It is this occasion that the Mouris gets to meet Kazuha Toyama for the first time. She approaches Ran to claims herself and Heiji to be inseparable while warns her not to be in between. Heiji has to step in and explain that the person whom he referred to as Kudo with Kazuha is actually "he" and not "she", thus resolving the misunderstanding. Kazuha reveals that she and Heiji once got stuck to each other with a pair of handcuffs when they were little, and they had to perform activities together until someone broke the handcuffs. Just as everyone is on their way to the next visit location, a body falls from a nearby building right onto their car. There is a person on top of the building, but it turns out he received someone’s request to rush to the location, thus becoming the eyewitness of the case. Heiji and Conan then come down from that building to investigate the scene, and Heiji immediately recognizes the man’s cause of death to be similar to the previous murders in Osaka. Just then, a woman becomes terrified upon seeing the body, and she escapes from the scene before the duo can ask more about her. Fortunately, Conan has already remembered her license plate so that they can investigate her later on. Location: Shinsai Bridge, Osaka Victim: Kazuto Noyasu Cause of death: Strangulation and stab wound The previous murders in Osaka that are still under investigation are revealed to the Mouris, including the way some victims had relation to each other: Sotaro Goshi has been reached out by some of the police because he had relation with the first victim and the third victim. The first victim who died in Toyonaka city is Hidetoshi Nagao, Goshi’s secretary who resigned after he took the blame for a stunning corruption case. The third victim who died in Hirakata city is Kazuto Noyasu, Goshi’s former personal chauffeur. Heiji (who is secretly carrying Conan now) and Sakata decide to come to Goshi's location to ask him on their own. Before Heiji leaves, Kazuha reminds him to always wear “it” along, to which he reassures her that he will never forget. Ran becomes curious so she asks Kazuha what she was referring to, and Kazuha reveals that ever since the tied together incident, she used two pieces of the broken handcuffs to create amulets for her and him, one for each. On the three detectives’ way to Goshi’s location, Sakata reveals to Heiji and Conan the identity of the woman that ran away from the third murder scene is Sumie Okazaki, and makes a call to her. At Okazaki’s apartment, she is terrified from the news about the murders. Sakata then makes a call to her, telling her not to go out the apartment. Unfortunately, he happens to drive past her apartment, forcing the two detectives to reach the apartment on their own. However, she is not there anymore and is found dead at a public toilet near West Side Apartments. Later, Sakata is holding the driving wheel and discussing with Heiji what should they do next while he is still thinking about the nightmare of him and Conan suffering the same fate as the victims. Suddenly, Sakata’s commentary on how hard the case is compared to identifying the victims makes Heiji question how the police can identify the victims so fast - the factor is the driver license, which is found on each wallet - the answer gives Conan and Heiji an idea to consult the vehicle license and registration department. Location: Public toilet next to West Side Apartments Victim: Sumie Okazaki Cause of death: Strangulation and stab wound At the department, the trio learn that Goshi and all victims have taken the same driving course 20 years ago, along with a person that everyone will feel disturbing when they hear the name: Ki'ichiro Numabuchi, a serial murderer who is currently on the run after he escaped from the prison. In addition, they discover that at the time that course graduated, their instructor died from an accident he caused when he was drunk. Suddenly, the three are approached by Ran, Kazuha, Kogoro, and Otaki, who went to their location to take Conan home. Before Conan has to be taken home while Heiji and Sakata continue their investigation, Heiji gives him his amulet and makes him promise not to do anything reckless.
